name: Tuxli

features.Deadly Speed: At the start of each scene, if the nimbleform singer isn’t Surprised, they can take a fast turn before any other characters (this doesn’t count as their turn this round).
features.Keen Senses: The nimbleform singer can spend 1 focus to gain an advantage on a Perception test (no action required).

Strike Mace.Description: Attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 3 (1d6) impact damage. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) impact damage.

Strike Shortbow.Description: Attack +5, range 80/320 ft., one target. Graze: 3 (1d6) keen damage. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) keen damage.

Chosen Target.Description: The nimbleform singer chooses an enemy they can sense within 120 feet of them. For 1 hour, when the nimbleform hits their chosen enemy with a weapon attack, they deal an extra 3 (1d6) damage. In addition, the nimbleform singer gains an advantage on Survival tests to track that enemy.

Tactics: While nimbleform singers rarely fight, they’re experts at tracking creatures and surveying an area, and they can easily exploit an enemy’s weakness using their Chosen Target action.
